pages.text: $(l)The Vat$()$(br)In order to get started in Mariculture you are going to want to craft a Vat. It is a simple machine that combines liquids, or liquids with items to make something else. To interact with the vat, simply right click an item or a liquid container on to it. To remove an item, shift and right click.
By default Vats only hold 6000mB of liquid. You can upgrade them by placing them in a 2x2, and they will then store up to 30000mB.
